lines: {target}? Sound travels farther than sense. I would bring the right tool and leave pride behind.
If anyone heads for Deep Dark, tell them: Walk soft and do not open every chest. I will be at the smithing table.
Sculk hears what pride forgets. I'll remember that when I tighten the handles.
Deep Dark is no small story. Broken tools are easier to mend than broken people.
I will remember Deep Dark as darkness that listens back. I will tighten the handles before trouble starts.
{target}? I would not rush toward it without telling someone where you are going first.
That kind of place makes a simple walk feel like a decision. Pack food, count your torches, and keep your head clear.
I have heard enough about {target} to know the quiet parts are usually the ones to worry about.
If you go there, come back with the story and not just the scratches. The village remembers both.
A place like {target} can turn confidence into <shake>panic</shake> very quickly.
